Finn "karrigan" Andersen (born April 14, 1990) is a Danish-German professional Counter-Strike 2 player and a former Counter-Strike: Global Offensive and Counter-Strike player who plays as the in-game leader for Team Falcons.

He is regarded as one of the most successful in-game leaders in Counter-Strike history, leading the Team SoloMid-Astralis core to multiple trophies before going on to make history by winning several trophies with the international FaZe Clan and mousesports lineups. After returning to FaZe Clan in 2021, he made history once again by being the first IGL to guide an international lineup to a Major victory, doing so at PGL Major Antwerp 2022. karrigan would leave FaZe in 2026 after 5 years with the team and sign to Team Falcons, with whom he would win the IEM Cologne Major 2026 just 61 days after joining.

karrigan is among the most decorated players in the scene, having won over 20 S-Tier tournaments throughout his career including two Majors and an Intel Grand Slam.

Trivia

[edit]

Personal

[edit]
  • Born to a German mother and Danish father. [3]
  • Graduated from Copenhagen Business School with a dual master's degree in Business Administration and Auditing in 2015. [4]

Records

[edit]
  • Most Majors played (22).
    • Tied with apEX.
  • Previously held the record for oldest Major winner, winning PGL Major Antwerp 2022 at 32 years and 42 days old. He dethroned Zeus as the former oldest Major winner, who won PGL Major Kraków 2017 at 29 years and 289 days old. He was overtaken by apEX, who won BLAST.tv Austin Major 2025 at 32 years and 121 days old. He once again holds the record for the oldest Major winner, winning IEM Cologne Major 2026 at 36 years and 68 days old.
  • Previously held the record for oldest ESL Grand Slam winner, winning Intel Grand Slam 4 at 32 years and 346 days old. He was overtaken by apEX, who won Season VI at 33 years and 56 days old.
  • Most Majors finals played (6).
  • Most Major finals lost (4).
    • Tied with GeT_RiGhT, f0rest, friberg and Xizt.

Awards

[edit]
  • Was ranked the 8th best player of 2011 by HLTV. [5]
  • Awarded IGL of the Year 2022 by HLTV. [6]

MVPs

[edit]
  • Was named the MVP of Electronic Sports World Cup 2011: Counter-Strike by HLTV. [7]
